findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived AWS credentials in Terraform state, source control, and to anyone with read access to the function configuration via console or API.

The Lambda function does not specify a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, so sensitive values like the embedded credentials rely only on default AWS-managed encryption, reducing control over key access, rotation, and auditability.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a deprecated Node.js runtime that no longer receives security patches from AWS, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities in the runtime environment.
